findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：競爭者已能複製部分產品功能或更快回應新技術；部分 OEM 客戶可能自行開發目前向 Garmin 採購的設備與零組件；公司可能無法使新產品適應新興技術。
findings.excerpt: Additionally, existing and emerging competitors have been able to replicate certain features offered by some of our products and services or respond more rapidly to emerging technologies or changes in customer requirements. Some of our original equipment manufacturer (OEM) customers may develop in-house equipment and components that they currently purchase from us.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：多項產品依賴 GNSS 與第三方衛星網路（Iridium、Skylo）；干擾（jamming）與欺騙（spoofing）可能損害定位功能。
findings.excerpt: Products and services that rely on the Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) are vulnerable to external interference, such as jamming and spoofing.

findings.claim: 車用導航業務因智慧型手機導航普及而喪失優勢；Garmin 靠非車用市場（航空、海事、戶外）多角化存活。
findings.source: Sure Dividend GRMN 分析報告
findings.excerpt: prominence due in large part to its automotive GPS devices. However, GPS devices for the automotive industry were rendered virtually obsolete with the widespread adoption of the smartphone.

findings.claim: 航空認證（FAA/EASA）構成進入門檻，Morningstar 認為 Garmin 具窄護城河。
findings.source: Morningstar: Garmin navigates its way to a narrow moat
